messages.author: e5bd953944aad325
messages.subject: g.part 5 re-run
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I am very new to the GGIR package and related usage. Where I am stuck at the moment is to re-run my meta for parts 4 and  5 to get the summary files. For some reason, all the codes ran fine and started generating reports for part 2 as requested, but never went to part 4 and 5. 

I have the raw data files pre-processed already and all the meta files are available. Does anyone know what code I should use to re-do part.5? In the GGIR manual, part 4 with an overwrite function is available. But the next topic is g.plot instead of g.part5 (unless part 4 and part 5 essentially can use the same code listed). It would be really helpful to get some feedback! 


Thank you!

Sharmin

messages.author: fe461312361bc741
messages.subject: Re: g.part 5 re-run
parts:
Hi Sharmin,

especially if you are new to GGIR I would recommend to use the shell function, it works best for me in any case. Maybe check out https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html If everything is set up properly, it will skip all steps which have already been processed and add what was missing. You may want to consider to start over with an empty output directory.

Good luck,
David

messages.subject: Re: g.part 5 re-run
parts:
Hi David,

Thank you very much for your feedback. I guess what's confusing me is how to re-run using any commands. I have my own script for the shell functions, and it loaded part 1 without any problems. It ran the whole file and started generating reports but stopped at part 2 only. Going back to re-run the shel from the cRAN script is a good way to start. Although it only specifies two modes, can I change that to 5? And should I use the meta directory to call the files or use the raw data files again? Creating a new output directory is a better idea and I already have created a new location. Sorry if these are redundant queries, but I'd like to know what you think, or how you would go about it?

Thanks again!!

Sharmin

messages.author: fe461312361bc741
messages.subject: Re: g.part 5 re-run
parts:
Hi Sharmin,

to re-run with changed options you can either set overwrite = T, or simply delete the respective meta data. It is unlikely, that you would require to do this with regard to part1. I tend to delete the ms2-5 folders when re-running these parts.
To process all parts set mode=c(1,2,3,4,5).

Cheers,
David
